text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: APEXHealth (apse1) dedicated pool p99 latency 3.2s (SLO 2.0s). Paging oncall @sam. RootTS=1718504321

sam: On it, I'm oncall. Starting triage — pulling pool and tenant metrics now.

lina: Joining. I'll get per-tenant QPS and queue depth. @mike can you check runtime logs for kv/cache pressure?

mike: Runtime: nodes 12-14 show elevated vram_swap and repeated KV cache misses. GC spikes correlate with p99 jumps.

jordan: FYI support routed the customer's report: user-facing slowness in APAC prod inference, no 5xxs reported, just high latency.

emily: I'm on the customer bridge. They confirm latency on production endpoints, users seeing slow responses. No job cancellations yet.

sam: Quick plan: 1) identify noisy tenant 2) soft-isolate/evict if >40% QPS 3) scale pool +2 GPUs if isolation doesn't get p99 < SLO 4) fall back to cross-region warm spare as last resort.

infra-bot: Runbook check: warm spare apse2 has 4 available GPUs. Scale command: `rictl scale-pool apex-apse1 --delta 2`.

lina: Top noisy tenant = `2fa-service` (≈47% QPS). Recommend immediate soft isolation of its routes.

sam: Executing isolation: `rictl isolate-tenant apex-apse1 --tenant 2fa-service --mode soft` — now.

infra-bot: isolate-tenant action accepted, progress ~15s to effect.

mike: Also toggling model fallback for that tenant to a quantized variant to reduce memory pressure: `toggle tenant/2fa-service model_fallback=true variant=redwood-hero-8bit`.

jordan: I've asked APEXHealth to pause background batch workers for the next 10m while we stabilize. They agreed.

emily: Customer wants ETA for recovery. I'll relay updates.

sam: Observability update: p99 dropping from 3.2s -> 2.1s within ~90s of isolation. Still slightly above SLO, moving to scale.

infra-bot: Executing scale: `rictl scale-pool apex-apse1 --delta 2` — provisioning expected ~180s.

lina: No spike in 5xxs, token costs normal. This looks like head-of-line queueing from the noisy tenant causing kvcache thrash.

mike: Deploying runtime hotfix (kvcache compaction tweak) as a canary on 1 node: `deploy runtime-hotfix --canary 1` to reduce swap.

sam: Run scale + hotfix canary in parallel. If p99 <2.0s after both, stop. Else, prepare cross-region failover.

infra-bot: Hotfix canary deployed to node-12. Early logs: `kvcache_compact` frequency up, swap events reduced.

lina: p99 now measured at 1.9s (21:18 UTC). Good improvement — monitoring for 10m baseline.

emily: Shared recovery with the customer. They're relieved and asked for an RCA + timeline.

sam: Handoff: Lina will own monitoring/RCA. Sam handing off at 21:20 UTC.

lina: Taking over. Draft RCA items: timeline, root cause = tenant traffic spike + kvcache thrash, mitigations = tenant isolation, scale + hotfix, follow-ups = auto-eviction threshold, tenant shaping, pre-warm pool in APAC.

jordan: I'll open the support ticket and confirm remediation window and follow-up briefing with APEXHealth.

infra-bot: Stabilization check: p99 within SLO for 10m. Recommend closing incident. Command: `incident close 1718504321`

sam: :white_check_mark: Closing after 15m stable. Thanks all — good coordination. :coffee:
